audit_review.time_note: WSL record time for audit approval; not VM audit time, board audit time, or NPU program runtime.

official_one_shot.reason: The official execution gate was not satisfied: matching kernel modules are absent/unloaded, the expected NPU/CMA device nodes are absent, the current bitstream provenance is unknown, and the documented npu_runtime/model artifact package is incomplete.

vendor_one_shot.reason: The official one-shot gate was not satisfied; no run evidence was created.

confirmed_facts: The real board is an AArch64 MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90 running Buildroot 2022.02.6 and Linux 6.1.111-rt42.
The board reserves 128 MiB of CMA, but only aic_load_fw is loaded and no hard_npu, soft_npu, or cma_mem module is loaded.
The board exposes a hard_npu device-tree/platform node with compatible anlogic,hard_npu, but no bound driver and no /dev/hard_npu node.
No /dev/soft_npu or /dev/cma_mem node was observed, and the board rootfs candidate search found no NPU runtime libraries, model artifacts, or matching modules.
The VM is Ubuntu 18.04.4 x86_64 with GCC/G++ 7.5.0 and glibc 2.27, but no cmake, ninja, docker, convert_tool, or al_ai_flow executable was found in the searched scope.
The VM SDK contains AArch64 Arm NN/ONNX parser libraries and Alnpu symbols, but no standalone libnpu_runtime package or prebuilt NPU modules.

unconfirmed_or_inferred.statement: The current eMMC image is not ready for the documented vendor one-shot path because its NPU driver/device prerequisites are absent.
The currently loaded FPGA bitstream may or may not contain SoftNPU logic; this audit did not inspect or alter the active bitstream.
unconfirmed_or_inferred.basis: No safe read-only identity mapping was available

unconfirmed_or_inferred.statement: The AArch64 Arm NN libraries may be ABI-compatible with the board, but their Alnpu backend cannot be validated without the matching runtime/driver/device path.
unconfirmed_or_inferred.basis: readelf identities plus absent board runtime

blocking_gaps: Kernel-compatible hard_npu.ko, soft_npu.ko, and cma_mem.ko package or a verified vendor image containing them
Verified /dev/hard_npu, /dev/soft_npu, and /dev/cma_mem nodes after a safe, approved driver deployment
Versioned standalone npu_runtime library and C API headers with AArch64/glibc/libstdc++ compatibility evidence
Official model artifact pair rt.bin and weight.bin plus its model/config identity
Host convert_tool and al_ai_flow package, or a vendor-supplied already converted official one-shot bundle
Verified mapping between the selected SoftNPU bitstream/DT and this exact DR1M90 eMMC image
minimum_next_step: Obtain from Anlogic/Milianke a version-matched DR1M90 Linux NPU runtime release for the current kernel/eMMC image: driver modules, npu_runtime headers/library, official one-shot ELF/source, official rt.bin/weight.bin and input, and the exact bitstream/DT provenance. Review and approve any board image or module-deployment change separately before execution.

driver: complete matching source, Makefile, kernel configuration/build instructions, vermagic, module order/parameters, expected dmesg/device nodes, and rollback steps
target identity: MLK-F3P-CZ02-DR1M90, AArch64, Buildroot 2022.02.6, Linux 6.1.111-rt42, glibc 2.25
runtime: C/C++ headers, version information, sample source and linking instructions
runtime configuration, license, dynamic dependencies, minimum glibc/libstdc++ requirements, Linux 6.1.111-rt42 compatibility matrix, API and error-code documentation
fpga_and_device_tree: matching Device Tree/overlay and kernel configuration
version mapping, safe load method, affected USB/network/eMMC functions, and rollback procedure
official_one_shot: official test image, model identity, rt.bin, weight.bin, configuration, run script and expected output
host_tools: supported operators, version matrix, host OS/Python requirements, input/output formats, YOLO limitations and license/dongle requirements

why_not_ready: The vendor runtime/device contract is not established; converting the frozen project model now would create an unsupported, untestable path.
